show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/YeDbB9
show.description: A seemingly perfect marriage shatters when Isha discovers her husband Virat’s secret affair with her closest friend. Pregnant, betrayed, and broken, Isha begins a silent countdown to walk away—while planning her own emotional comeback. As obsession, lies, and power games spiral out of control, love turns poisonous and revenge becomes inevitable. Husband, Wife and Others is a dark, gripping tale of betrayal, survival, and a woman reclaiming her shattered identity.
